recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-13802 unless a separate issue asks to update unrelated historical URLs or further revise the current comparison service.
issue_request: FHIR-13802 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 change request reporting that Build page Compare links, such as Observation's "Compare to DSTU3", generated an htmldiff URL whose new document pointed at http://hl7-fhir.github.io//observation.html and returned 404.
initial_application: The Jira comment says "sorted." Git history shows commit 8dd23fc9b4dd1101de72c7d8bafb76ad12771b24, "#13802 - fix broken paths," changed build.sh to publish the CI build with http://build.fhir.org/ rather than http://hl7-fhir.github.io/ and updated adjacent stale references.
additional_context: The current build no longer has a DSTU3 compare link in tools/templates/newfooter.html. Its compare links use https://www.fhir.org/perl/htmldiff.pl with current release targets and <%baseURL%><%rellink%> for the new document. build.sh still passes -url http://build.fhir.org/. A live check of https://build.fhir.org/observation.html produced compare links whose newfile parameter is http%3A%2F%2Fbuild.fhir.org%2Fobservation.html, not the obsolete GitHub Pages URL. Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-13802 discussion or conflicting work-group evidence; later Zulip htmldiff discussion only explains the modern move away from the W3C service.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was needed because the active source and rendered build behavior already avoid the broken URL that FHIR-13802 reported.

related_jiras.note: Later commit 98f60cf87e adjusted comparison targets after the same footer template moved on from STU3/R4-era links, showing normal version-maintenance rather than an unresolved FHIR-13802 defect.
